3.7.1.3 Features to allow time deterministic implementation of applications
Time deterministic implementation of applications requires to be able to specify timing constraints and analyze timing properties at different stages of development, i.e. during virtual integration on VFB level, development of SW-Cs, and finally the integration of SW-Cs into ECUs and of ECUs into a system of ECUs. Furthermore, the runtime environment must provide suitable mechanisms to enforce deterministic timing. The following Figure illustrates a specification of VFB timing.
